systems.system: Governance Reform and Accountability Transformation (GREAT) Project
systems.owner: World Bank (IDA credit of US$30 million to Liberia, appraisal dated 7 May 2024); Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications runs the eLiberia Portal component
systems.tiers: Digitalisation of selected services, including at County Service Centers; financed technical assistance for the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications to define a digitalization strategy for all public services

note: The appraisal document says the project will finance a ministry digitalization strategy for public services, still to be defined; no existing strategy is named.
